instruction: Get all routes at /api/routes. How many routes are there?
Search stops at /api/stops?q=park. How many stops match?
Go to /api/routes/1. What is the route name?
Go to /api/stats. How many total stops are there?
Filter routes by type at /api/routes?type=local. How many local routes?
Sort routes by travel time at /api/routes?sort=travel_time. What is the first route name?
Compute fare at /api/fares/compute?zone=A&rider=adult&pass_type=single_ride. What is the fare amount?
Find the fastest route at /api/routes/extremum?metric=travel_time&order=min. What is the route name?
Get the 2nd ranked route by travel time at /api/routes/ranked?metric=travel_time&rank=2. What route?
Compare routes at /api/compare?ids=1,2. How many routes are returned?
Get fares for zone A at /api/fares?zone=A. Does it return fare data?
Plan a trip at /api/trip-plan?origin=Downtown&destination=Airport&preference=fastest. Does it return options?
Export routes at /api/export?data=routes&format=csv. Does it return CSV data?
POST /api/share with type=link, content_type=route, content_id=1. Does it return a share URL?
Find nearby stops at /api/stops/nearby?lat=47.25&lng=-122.44&radius=2. How many nearby stops?
Plan a trip with preference=cheapest at /api/trip-plan?origin=Downtown&destination=University&preference=cheapest. Does it return options?
Plan a trip for a specific date at /api/trip-plan?origin=Downtown&destination=Airport&date=2026-07-06. How many options?
Get the most frequent route at /api/routes/extremum?metric=frequency&order=min. What is the route name?
Filter stops by zone at /api/stops?zone=A&sort=name. How many zone A stops?
Get schedule for route 1 at /api/routes/1/schedule. Does it return schedule data?
